questions.title: What a Constructor Is
questions.description: A constructor in Java is best described as:
questions.Option1: An ordinary method that must be called manually after the object exists
questions.Option2: A special member that shares the class name and runs automatically when an object is created with new
questions.Option3: A keyword that releases the memory of a destroyed object
questions.Option4: A static block that runs when the class is loaded
